y-m-31-01.topic: Ukuhlola isixazululo mayelana ne-variance ne-standard deviation
y-m-31-01.goal: Thola umugqa ophosile esixazululweni se-variance ne-standard deviation, sho umkhondo wokuthi umphumela ubukeka uyinqaba ngaphandle kokubala kabusha kuze kube sekugcineni, futhi wenze wena enye isethi yedatha enesilinganiso esifanayo ne-variance.
y-m-31-01.material: Amamaki ezivivinyo (amaphuzu) abafundi abangu-5 beqembu likaMinseo angu-4, 7, 5, 8, 11. Ukuthola ukuthi le datha isabalele kangakanani, uMinseo wayixazulula kanje ngezansi. Umugqa owodwa wesixazululo sikaMinseo awulungile. Laba bafundi abangu-5 bangabantu bonke abaphenyiwe, ngakho i-variance itholakala ngokuhlukanisa ngo-5.

y-m-31-01.thinking.2: Ukwenza enye isethi yedatha eyanelisa zonke izimo

Umugqa 6 wathuthela i-variance engu-6 ngqo njenge-standard deviation. I-standard deviation akuyona i-variance kodwa impande yesikwele ephozithivu ye-variance, ngakho ingu-√6 (2.4 amaphuzu cishe).

y-m-31-03.title: Isilinganiso sakhuphuka kodwa umaphakathi wahlala unjalo

y-m-31-03.material: Amaphuzu okuhlolwa komsebenzi (amaphuzu) abafundi abangu-5 ayengu-60, 65, 70, 75, 80. Kokubili isilinganiso ne-median kungamaphuzu angu-70. Izindinganiso zokuhlola zabuyekezwa, futhi kwabuyekezwa kuphela amaphuzu omfundi owayenamaphuzu angu-60 nomfundi owayenamaphuzu angu-80. Bita amaphuzu amasha ngamaphuzu a nama-b (izinombolo ezigcwele kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-100), futhi amaphuzu abanye abafundi abathathu (amaphuzu angu-65, amaphuzu angu-70, amaphuzu angu-75) ahlala njengoba enjalo. Ngemva kokubuyekezwa, isilinganiso sakhuphuka ngamaphuzu angu-4 noma ngaphezulu kusuka ku-70, kodwa i-median yahlala ingamaphuzu angu-70.
